title: CivAgent match event
description: One line of ~/.civagent/matches/<matchId>/events.jsonl. The stable contract the frontend consumes. Each line is an independent JSON object.

regime.description: region/regime-id, e.g. china/tang. Present on match_start.

backend.description: Backend id, e.g. native, cn:doubao. Present on match_start.

command.description: Resolved binary the backend mapped to. Present on match_start.

task.description: The governance task. Present on match_start.

text.description: Streamed output chunk. Present on turn events.

exitCode.description: Process exit code. Present on match_end.

provider.description: Judge provider id. Present on judge events.

error.description: Failure reason, when a judge/skill step failed.

status.description: Sedimentation outcome. Present on skill events.

skillPath.description: Absolute path of the saved skill file. Present on skill events when status=saved.

auditedBy.description: Provider that audited the skill. Present on skill events when an audit was attempted.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for rejected/skipped/error status. Present on skill events.

examples.text: 门下省 reviews the draft edict ...
